title: Customer #123: invoice total does not match order total
author: support-lena
body:
Customer #123 has an order totaling $150, but the invoice shows $175. Investigate the discrepancy.

- Order: #6800
- What the customer sees under "My orders": $150.00
- What the invoice PDF says: $175.00

The customer wants to know which amount is right and whether they were overcharged. This is the third ticket like this in two weeks, so it may not be a one-off.

comments.author: finance-omar
comments.body: Please also tell us how many invoices are affected. We cannot edit issued invoices; corrections need a credit note (see the finance runbook).
